topic: Day 131 — reel — Holding an old version of someone blinds you to who's in front of you now
text:
You updated.
So did they.
Your [model]
didn't.
caption:
Mental models of people don't refresh on their own. You end up responding to a version that stopped existing years ago.

Follow for one of these a day.
